translations.web: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
translations.bsb: Immediately the boy’s father cried out, “I do believe; help my unbelief!”
translations.kjv: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
translations.asv: Straightway the father of the child cried out, and said, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
